name: smart-limits
description: Lets the model compact the conversation at a point of its own choosing once the context window is past a threshold, and holds the work when a subscription window is nearly used up.

compactAt.title: Compact at
compactAt.description: Percent of the context window from which the model is reminded, on every tool result, to ask for a compaction at a good point; the conversation is compacted when that turn ends and a prompt wakes the model. 0 turns it off.

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: What every summary should keep, added after the model's own note. Empty: the model's note alone.

limitSoft.title: Soft limit
limitSoft.description: Percent of a subscription window at which a toast warns once per window. 0 turns it off.

limitHard.title: Hard limit
limitHard.description: Percent of a subscription window at which the command below runs once and Bash, Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and new agents are refused until the window resets. 0 turns it off.

atHard.title: Command at the hard limit
atHard.description: A slash command run once when the hard limit is crossed, written as typed after the slash (name, then arguments after a space): the pause command of whatever drives the work. Empty: none.

atReset.title: Command after the hard limit clears
atReset.description: A slash command run once when no window holds the hard limit any more (the window reset), written as typed after the slash: the command that continues the paused work. Empty: none.
